_comment: Body for POST https://api-v2.fattureincloud.it/c/{company_id}/subscriptions (WebhooksApi.create_webhooks_subscription). Event type names from developers.fattureincloud.it/docs/webhooks/notification-types/. The sink must be HTTPS and answer the GET verification with {"verification": <x-fic-verification-challenge>}.

receiver_contract.auth: Authorization: Bearer <JWT ES256>; check jti == ce-id, sub == ce-subject, aud == sink, exp (3h)
receiver_contract.retryable: 5xx, 4 attempts in total, then the notification is discarded
receiver_contract.unretryable: any other status including 3xx; 410 deletes the subscription
receiver_contract.expiry: first error sets an expiration date 10 days later; one success clears it
receiver_contract.delivery: at-least-once, usually ordered; dedupe on ce-id, order by ce-time
receiver_contract.body: data.ids only: read the resource with the matching Get method
